details.description:
Tiny undead

GM: What is left of a lich that kept its phylactery too long: a skull, a handful of dust and a hunger for souls. It is the deadliest trap in the dungeon, and it looks like treasure.

Solo: Undead. A normal creature of its Level unless the GM runs it as a solo (tick Run as solo before the fight). As a solo: it fights in three phases with this HP in each; at 0 HP its next phase starts at full HP (damage beyond 0 is lost) and every condition and hostile effect on it ends; at its first phase change only, its breath weapons and other limited-use abilities recover (never spells); once a round, so for the rest of a round in which it changed phase damage can't take it below 1 HP; at 0 HP in its third phase it dies (all automatic). It acts twice a round, on its initiative and again 10 lower (the second turn repeats its attacks, never a spell or limited ability). Villain actions: the undead type's three (in its abilities, worked out for its Level); the opener straight after the first enemy turn, the crowd control after the turn that starts its second phase, the ultimate after the turn that starts its third; it skips its second turn in a round it uses one, if that turn is still to come. Anything that stops it acting, attacking, moving or casting, or banishes, imprisons or petrifies it, ends after two of its turns (one, the second time in a fight), then nothing of the kind affects it until the end of the following round. A kill effect deals damage equal to its current HP (yours to apply). Area, aura and ongoing damage come once a round, at the start of its first turn.

As a normal creature: its HP once, one turn a round, no villain actions and no shaking it off. Its breath weapons, spells and other powers that hit more than one creature deal half damage.

system.description:
Immune to poison, sleep, charm, fear and psychic damage, and to damage from non-magical weapons.

  • Resistance 10 to all other damage except force and radiant.
  • Cannot be @Condition[paralysed]{Paralysed}, @Condition[petrified]{Petrified}, @Condition[poisoned]{Poisoned}, @Condition[stunned]{Stunned} or knocked prone.
On a successful save against an effect that deals half damage on a success, it takes none.

Once per day, as an action, every creature within 30ft that can hear it makes a @Check[fort|dc:23]{Fortitude save DC 23} or takes @Damage[10d10 necrotic]{10d10 necrotic damage}, half on a success; a creature reduced to 0 HP by it falls @Condition[unconscious]{Unconscious} and stable. A creature that saves is @Condition[frightened]{Frightened} until the end of its next turn.

As an action, up to three creatures within 10ft make a @Check[fort|dc:19]{Fortitude save DC 19} or take @Damage[6d6 necrotic]{6d6 necrotic damage}, and the demilich regains the total. This is also its second action each round.

Once per day, as an action, it targets one creature within 30ft: @Check[will|dc:23]{Will save DC 23} or its soul is pulled into one of the gems in the demilich's skull, and its body crumbles. A soul trapped for 24 hours is devoured; breaking the gem before then frees it, and @UUID[Compendium.arneyan.spells.Item.RjGWGxIhUqHUiLMv]{wish} or @UUID[Compendium.arneyan.spells.Item.8XhTI839UkXWg4Sr]{true resurrection} can return it.
The skull rests, apparently harmless, until a creature disturbs its treasure or lair; then it rises.

Each enemy within 60ft that can see it makes a @Check[will|dc:23]{Will save DC 23} or is @Condition[frightened]{Frightened}, taking @Damage[2d6 necrotic]{2d6 necrotic damage}.

An undead solo's opener (Running a Solo, Monsters & Treasure). Every rider lasts until the end of the target's next turn.

items.name: Villain Action 2 (Crowd Control): Grip of the Grave

system.description:
Bony hands claw out of the ground in a 20ft radius within 60ft. Each creature there makes a @Check[ref|dc:23]{Reflex save DC 23}, taking @Damage[4d6 necrotic]{4d6 necrotic damage} and being @Condition[restrained]{Restrained} on a failure, or half damage on a success.

An undead solo's crowd control (Running a Solo, Monsters & Treasure). Every rider lasts until the end of the target's next turn.

One creature within 60ft makes a @Check[fort|dc:23]{Fortitude save DC 23}, taking @Damage[6d8 necrotic]{6d8 necrotic damage} and being unable to regain HP on a failure, or half damage on a success. An undead that fights with a weapon or bite may instead make its full attack line against that creature, with the same rider on a hit.

An undead solo's ultimate (Running a Solo, Monsters & Treasure). Every rider lasts until the end of the target's next turn.
